name: Contemporary Gods
source:
The human world is falling apart, and the cracks have appeared even in the realm of the gods. As the deity of Unity, you are tasked with convincing the most powerful gods--Social Media, Capitalism, and Identity--to work together for the benefit of humanity... Just one problem*: they all hate each other!

*there are actually many problems

[From [URL=https://forgetmenotgames.itch.io/contemporary-gods]itch.io[/URL]]
translation:
人类世界正在分崩离析，裂痕甚至蔓延到了神明的领域。身为团结之神，你受命说服最强大的几位神明——社交媒体之神、资本主义之神与身份认同之神，为人类的利益携手合作。只有一个问题*，他们全都讨厌彼此！

*其实有很多问题。

[摘自[URL=https://forgetmenotgames.itch.io/contemporary-gods]itch.io[/URL]]
